# Version 4.150.0
> **Skia m150 and APIs** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates the bundled engine to Skia m150 and adds practical image and paint APIs. The release adds filters and diagnostics APIs, improves canvas-wrapper performance, and restores correct small-radius CPU raster blurs.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m150** — The bundled renderer advances to Chrome milestone 150 with the associated upstream fixes. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146), [#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## API Surface

- **New image-filter and paint helpers** — SKImageFilter adds crop and empty filters, SKColorFilter adds overdraw visualization, and SKPaint adds fast-bounds calculation for culling. ([#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228), [#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))

## Bug Fixes

- **Small-radius raster blur regression fixed** — CPU raster rendering restores the expected quality for small-sigma blur effects. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKSurface canvas wrapper cached** — Repeated Canvas access on an SKSurface reuses its managed wrapper, reducing allocation and interop overhead. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))
